title: Employee Relationships — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A relationship between this employee and another employee — for example a spouse or relative working in the same organisation.

It is recorded for reference; no calculation or approval step reads it at present.

fields.label: RelationshipType
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Relationship Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. How the two employees are related.

Example. Spouse
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under General Master Info → Relationship Types.

fields.label: RelatedEmployee
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.
fields.html:
What it is. The other employee.

Example. Sara Al-Mutairi (1188)

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee and relationship type.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.
